import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    c = np.cos(p[9]*t); s = np.sin(p[9]*t)
    return p[0] + p[1]*v + p[2]*v**2 + p[3]*v**3 + p[4]*x + p[5]*c + p[6]*s + p[7]*v*c + p[8]*v*s
